title: Latency, persisters, and DosR
dek: LTBI is an immune-operational category. Persistence is a physiologic spectrum (DosR, lipid bodies, non-replicating states). Do not fuse the words.
story: Latent TB infection (LTBI) in clinic means a positive TST/IGRA after active disease has been excluded. It does not map one-to-one onto a named granuloma full of culture-positive bacilli, and a negative IGRA does not prove sterility. Most infected people never develop disease; risk is concentrated in recent infection, HIV, anti-TNF, dialysis, silicosis, and young children.

Separately, Mtb has measurable non-replicating persistent states. The DosRS (DevRS) two-component system plus DosT senses hypoxia, NO, and CO and drives a ~50-gene dormancy regulon (including hspX). The Wayne hypoxic-shift-down model and lipid-body “foamy” bacilli are laboratory handles on that physiology.

TPT (3HP, 1HP, 3HR, 6H, 4R, 6Lfx for MDR contacts) is a public-health bet that a small persisting population can be extinguished with one or two drugs because mutation supply is low. It is not the same bet as treating a cavity.
deepTitle: Genes, models, and the clinical word
deep: dosR mutants are attenuated in some persistence models and not in all. Do not write “DosR = LTBI gene” on a report.
hspX (α-crystallin) is a DosR-offspring antigen sometimes used in research serology; it is not a WHO disease test.
RelA/SpoT-mediated stringent response and trans-translation (hisT, etc.) are additional persistence axes. The genome has more than one way to sit still.
Resuscitation-promoting factors (Rpfs) matter when you try to culture “dormant” bacilli. Negative culture is not proof of absence in tissue.

visual.caption: Schematic replication-rate distributions. Broth log-phase is a tight, fast peak. Caseum/persisters shift mass toward slow replication. LTBI is a clinical label overlaying an unknown mix of those states — often near zero detectable replication.

example.title: Why 3HP is not 2HRZE
example.setup: Household contact, IGRA+, normal CXR, smear-negative, asymptomatic. Clinician asks why weekly rifapentine–INH is enough.

steps.title: Burden
steps.body: Mutation supply scales with N. A contained, paucibacillary state is not a 3+ cavity.

steps.title: Rule out disease
steps.body: TPT is illegal-in-spirit (and guideline-illegal) if you are actually treating disease with two weekly drugs. Symptom/CXR/mWRD screen first.

steps.title: Regimen grammar
steps.body: 3HP is WHO-preferred TPT, not a shortened HRZE. Different object, different endpoint (incident TB, not cavity closure).

example.takeaway: LTBI treatment is a low-N persistence bet after disease exclusion.

check.prompt: A positive IGRA with disease excluded demonstrates:
choices: Culture-proven persisters in a named granuloma
T-cell memory to Mtb antigens, used operationally as LTBI
DosR overexpression in sputum RNA-seq by definition
check.answer: T-cell memory to Mtb antigens, used operationally as LTBI
check.why: Do not fuse immunoassay and Wayne-model physiology.

whyWrong.Culture-proven persisters in a named gra: Not part of the LTBI definition.

check.prompt: DosR (DevR) with DosS/DosT senses hypoxia/NO/CO and induces ~50 genes including hspX. This regulon is best used as:
choices: A physiologic persistence programme, not a DST catalogue gene
check.answer: A physiologic persistence programme, not a DST catalogue gene
check.why: Catalogue genes are rpoB, katG, etc. DosR is physiology.
